verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single pricing-page tagline, "Build AI‑powered audiences from a complete customer view", which suggests some in-product AI applied to customer data but does not describe AI-generated insights or suggestions. Other items do not count toward this story: the Profile API recommendation-engine use case is a developer building block, and the "Open in ChatGPT/Claude" links are a docs-site feature. Missing for 10: documented in-product AI insights or suggestions surfaced from the user's data, details of what the AI-powered audience feature generates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
